<style>
.ckst{--paper:#f5efe2;--paper2:#efe6d4;--honey:#f1e4c6;--ink:#2a2118;--ink2:#574b39;--dim:#8a7a5c;--edge:#d8ccb0;--mag:#c02d9a;--teal:#3fa892;--dark:#1e1712;--darkstage:#2a2118;
  font-family:"Courier New",Courier,monospace;color:var(--ink);background:var(--paper);line-height:1.55;
  width:100vw;margin-left:calc(50% - 50vw);margin-right:calc(50% - 50vw);overflow-x:hidden}
.ckst *{box-sizing:border-box}
.ckst .wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 22px}
.ckst .k{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink2)}
.ckst .k b{color:var(--mag);font-weight:700}
.ckst h2{font-size:clamp(26px,3.6vw,40px);line-height:1.12;margin:10px 0 14px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.ckst p{font-size:16px;max-width:62ch;margin:0 0 14px}
.ckst a{color:var(--mag)}
.ckst .btn{display:inline-block;border:1.6px solid var(--ink);border-radius:9px;padding:12px 20px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink);background:var(--paper2);box-shadow:0 1px 0 #fff9 inset,0 2px 0 #0001}
.ckst .btn.acc{background:var(--mag);border-color:var(--mag);color:#fff}
.ckst .btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}
.ckst .sec{padding:72px 0}
.ckst .rule{border:0;border-top:1.6px solid var(--ink);margin:0}
/* hero */
.ckst .hero{position:relative;background:var(--honey);padding:112px 0 0;overflow:hidden}
.ckst .stage{position:relative;height:clamp(420px,58vh,620px)}
.ckst .stage canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.ckst .heroText{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:34px;z-index:2;pointer-events:none}
.ckst .heroText .wrap{pointer-events:auto}
.ckst .wm{margin:0;line-height:.9;font-size:clamp(58px,11vw,124px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.02em;white-space:nowrap}
.ckst .wm span{position:relative;display:inline-block;transform:rotate(calc(var(--s)*var(--s)*.1deg)) translateY(calc(var(--s)*var(--s)*-.06px))}
.ckst .wm span::before,.ckst .wm span::after{content:attr(data-l);position:absolute;left:0;top:0;z-index:-1;opacity:calc(.22 + var(--s)*var(--s)*.013)}
.ckst .wm span::before{color:var(--teal);transform:translate(calc(var(--s)*var(--s)*.14px),calc(var(--s)*var(--s)*.1px)) rotate(calc(var(--s)*var(--s)*.11deg))}
.ckst .wm span::after{color:var(--mag);transform:translate(calc(var(--s)*var(--s)*.25px),calc(var(--s)*var(--s)*-.06px)) rotate(calc(var(--s)*var(--s)*-.11deg))}
.ckst .tag{font-size:clamp(14px,1.7vw,19px);color:var(--ink2);margin:8px 0 0;letter-spacing:.04em}
.ckst .heroBar{background:var(--paper);border-top:1.6px solid var(--ink);padding:26px 0 30px}
.ckst .heroBar .wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:18px 28px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.ckst .pitch{font-size:clamp(17px,2vw,21px);max-width:44ch;margin:0}
.ckst .cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;align-items:center}
.ckst .fmt{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--ink2)}
/* grids */
.ckst .grid{display:grid;gap:18px}
.ckst .g3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.ckst .g2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
.ckst .card{border:1.6px solid var(--ink);border-radius:14px;background:var(--paper);padding:20px 20px 18px;position:relative}
.ckst .card .t{position:absolute;top:-9px;left:14px;background:var(--paper);padding:0 6px;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--ink2)}
.ckst .card h3{margin:4px 0 8px;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:.04em}
.ckst .card p{font-size:14.5px;margin:0;color:var(--ink2)}
.ckst .shot{border:1.6px solid var(--ink);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 18px 44px #0002;background:var(--paper)}
.ckst .shot img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
.ckst .two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:38px;align-items:center}
/* dark band */
.ckst .dark{background:var(--dark);color:var(--paper)}
.ckst .dark .k{color:#bfae92}.ckst .dark p{color:#d8ccb0}.ckst .dark .shot{border-color:#e9dfca;background:var(--darkstage)}
/* the gallery rail */
.ckst .rail{position:relative;margin:26px 0 0}
.ckst .rail::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;bottom:14px;right:0;width:110px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(245,239,226,0),var(--paper));pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .35s}
.ckst .rail.end::after{opacity:0}
.ckst .railHint{color:var(--mag);transition:opacity .5s}.ckst .rail.moved .railHint{opacity:0}
.ckst .railIn{display:flex;gap:16px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;padding:4px 2px 14px;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:var(--edge) transparent;outline:none}
.ckst .railIn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--mag);outline-offset:4px}
.ckst .eqc{flex:0 0 auto;width:min(78vw,300px);scroll-snap-align:start;margin:0;border:1.2px solid var(--edge);border-radius:12px;background:var(--paper);overflow:hidden}
.ckst .eqStage{position:relative;background:var(--honey);aspect-ratio:4/3}
.ckst .eqStage canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.ckst .eqStage .n{position:absolute;left:10px;top:8px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink2);opacity:.75}
.ckst .eqc figcaption{padding:10px 12px 11px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:0 10px;align-items:end}
.ckst .eqc b{font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.03em;grid-column:1}
.ckst .eqc i{font-style:normal;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mag);grid-column:1}
.ckst .eqc span{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink2);grid-column:1}
.ckst .eqc .hear{grid-column:2;grid-row:1/4;font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-decoration:none;border:1.2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 9px;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap}
.ckst .railNav{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:4px;font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--ink2)}
.ckst .railNav div{display:flex;gap:8px}
.ckst .railNav button{border:1.4px solid var(--ink);border-radius:8px;background:var(--paper2);color:var(--ink);font:700 12px/1 "Courier New",Courier,monospace;letter-spacing:.08em;padding:10px 13px;cursor:pointer}
/* hear it */
.ckst .hz{margin-top:24px}
.ckst .hzTop{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 18px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:12px}
.ckst .hzSrc{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.ckst .hzOff{display:none;max-width:52ch;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:.04em;font-size:12px}
.ckst .hz.off .hzOff{display:block}.ckst .hz.off .hzPlay,.ckst .hz.off .hzVol{display:none}
.ckst .hzVol{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.ckst .hzVol input{width:150px;accent-color:var(--mag);cursor:pointer}
.ckst .hzStage{position:relative;border:1.6px solid var(--ink);border-radius:14px;background:var(--honey);aspect-ratio:21/9;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 14px 36px #0001}
.ckst .hzStage canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.ckst .hzNow{position:absolute;left:14px;bottom:12px;max-width:68%;pointer-events:none}
.ckst .hzNow b{display:block;font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.2em}
.ckst .hzNow i{display:block;font-style:normal;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink2)}
.ckst .hzPlay{position:absolute;right:12px;bottom:12px;border:1.6px solid var(--mag);border-radius:9px;background:var(--mag);color:#fff;font:700 12.5px/1 "Courier New",Courier,monospace;letter-spacing:.08em;padding:11px 14px;cursor:pointer}
.ckst .hzChips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:12px}
.ckst .chip{border:1.4px solid var(--edge);border-radius:8px;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font:12.5px/1 "Courier New",Courier,monospace;letter-spacing:.04em;padding:10px 11px;cursor:pointer;min-height:38px}
.ckst .chip.on{border-color:var(--ink);background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper)}
.ckst .chip.on[data-clip="dry"]{border-color:var(--mag);background:var(--mag);color:#fff}
.ckst .chip.miss{opacity:.35;cursor:default}
/* buy */
.ckst .buy{border:1.6px solid var(--ink);border-radius:18px;padding:34px 34px 30px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;gap:30px;align-items:center;background:var(--paper2)}
.ckst .buy h2{margin:6px 0 10px}
.ckst .facts{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink2);margin:10px 0 18px}
.ckst .buyRow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px 22px;align-items:center}
.ckst .big{font-size:clamp(40px,5vw,58px);font-weight:700;line-height:1}
.ckst .fine{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink2);margin-top:16px}
.ckst .req{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;font-size:14.5px}
.ckst .req li{padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px dotted var(--edge)}
.ckst .req li::before{content:"[ x ]  ";color:var(--mag);font-weight:700}
/* the bar that follows you down (like Pro-Osc): shows once the hero is gone */
.ckst .bar{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:9990;background:rgba(245,239,226,.94);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border-bottom:1.6px solid var(--ink);transform:translateY(-102%);transition:transform .32s ease;font-family:"Courier New",Courier,monospace}
.ckst .bar.show{transform:none}
.ckst .barIn{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 22px;height:58px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px}
.ckst .barName{font-weight:700;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none}
.ckst .barKick{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink2);white-space:nowrap}
.ckst .barTabs{margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center}
.ckst .barTabs a{font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:8px;border:1.4px solid transparent}
.ckst .barTabs a.on{border-color:var(--ink)}
.ckst .barTabs a:hover{background:var(--paper2)}
.ckst .barBuy{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#fff;background:var(--mag);border:1.6px solid var(--mag);border-radius:9px;padding:10px 14px;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;margin-left:8px}
.ckst section[id]{scroll-margin-top:66px}
@media (max-width:860px){.ckst .barKick{display:none}}
@media (max-width:640px){.ckst .barTabs a[data-sec]{display:none}.ckst .barIn{height:52px}.ckst .barName{font-size:16px}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ckst .bar{transition:none}}
/* faq */
.ckst details{border-bottom:1px solid var(--edge);padding:12px 0}
.ckst summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;font-size:16px;list-style:none}
.ckst summary::before{content:"+  ";color:var(--mag)}
.ckst details[open] summary::before{content:"-  "}
.ckst details p{margin:8px 0 2px;color:var(--ink2);font-size:15px}
.ckst .strip{overflow:hidden;border-top:1.6px solid var(--ink);border-bottom:1.6px solid var(--ink);padding:12px 0;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--ink2);white-space:nowrap}
.ckst .stripIn{display:inline-block;animation:ckstStrip 90s linear infinite}
.ckst .strip:hover .stripIn{animation-play-state:paused}
@keyframes ckstStrip{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ckst .stripIn{animation:none}}
.ckst .foot{padding:40px 0 56px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink2);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
@media (max-width:860px){
  .ckst .g3{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.ckst .two{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .ckst .buy{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ckst .hzStage{aspect-ratio:16/10}.ckst .stage{height:clamp(340px,52vh,520px)}
}
@media (max-width:560px){.ckst .g3,.ckst .g2{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ckst .sec{padding:52px 0}.ckst .eqc{width:min(74vw,300px)}.ckst .hzStage{aspect-ratio:4/3}.ckst .hzNow{max-width:60%}.ckst .buy{padding:26px 22px 24px}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ckst .btn:hover{transform:none}}
</style>

<div class="ckst" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/Product">
  <meta itemprop="name" content="Strange">
  <meta itemprop="brand" content="Clay and Kelsy Instruments">
  <meta itemprop="description" content="A chaos-equation distortion plugin for Mac. Twenty strange attractors, a live plotter that draws the real equation you are hearing, 62 presets. VST3, AU and standalone.">

  <!-- THE BAR: slides in once the hero has scrolled away -->
  <div class="bar" aria-label="Strange page navigation"><div class="barIn">
    <a class="barName" href="#strange-top">Strange</a><span class="barKick">a chaos-equation distortion &middot; effect</span>
    <nav class="barTabs"><a href="#strange-math" data-sec="strange-math">The math</a><a href="#strange-hear" data-sec="strange-hear">Hear it</a><a href="#strange-inside" data-sec="strange-inside">Inside</a><a href="#strange-buy" data-sec="strange-buy">Buy</a><a class="barBuy" href="BUY_URL">[ BUY &middot; PRICE ]</a></nav>
  </div></div>

  <!-- HERO: the plotter draws itself, live -->
  <section class="hero" id="strange-top">
    <div class="stage">
      <canvas id="ckst-trail"></canvas>
      <canvas id="ckst-over"></canvas>
      <div class="heroText"><div class="wrap">
        <div class="k"><b>Clay and Kelsy Instruments</b> &middot; effect &middot; VST3 / AU / standalone</div>
        <h1 class="wm" aria-label="Strange"><span data-l="S" style="--s:0">S</span><span data-l="T" style="--s:1">T</span><span data-l="R" style="--s:2">R</span><span data-l="A" style="--s:3">A</span><span data-l="N" style="--s:4">N</span><span data-l="G" style="--s:5">G</span><span data-l="E" style="--s:6">E</span></h1>
        <p class="tag">a chaos-equation distortion</p>
      </div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="heroBar"><div class="wrap">
      <p class="pitch">Twenty strange attractors, and your signal falls into one of them. Turn AMOUNT up and warm saturation period-doubles into full chaos, while the plotter draws the real equation you&rsquo;re hearing.</p>
      <div class="cta">
        <a class="btn acc" href="BUY_URL" itemprop="url">[ BUY STRANGE &middot; PRICE ]</a>
        <a class="btn" href="#strange-hear">[ HEAR IT ]</a>
        <span class="fmt">MAC &middot; VST3 &middot; AU &middot; STANDALONE</span>
      </div>
    </div></div>
  </section>

  <!-- THE IDEA -->
  <section class="sec"><div class="wrap two">
    <div>
      <div class="k">The idea</div>
      <h2>Distortion has always been one curve.</h2>
      <p>Every overdrive, every fuzz, every saturator is a fixed shape you push a signal through. Strange replaces the shape with a living system: the Lorenz attractor, Chua&rsquo;s circuit, the logistic map. Equations that never settle, never repeat, never quite do the same thing twice.</p>
      <p>Your audio isn&rsquo;t shaped by them. It falls into them.</p>
      <p>It&rsquo;s not a distortion with a chaos setting. It&rsquo;s chaos, with a distortion knob.</p>
    </div>
    <figure class="shot" style="margin:0"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," width="1100" height="887" decoding="async" alt="Strange plugin window: the plotter drawing Chua's circuit above the CHAOS, MOTION, FILTER and OUTPUT controls" itemprop="image"></figure>
  </div></section>

  <hr class="rule">

  <!-- THE MATH: twenty live plotters -->
  <section class="sec" id="strange-math"><div class="wrap">
    <div class="k">The math</div>
    <h2>Twenty strange attractors, live.</h2>
    <p>Fourteen maps and six flows, each one a different kind of unstable. Some crunch like a broken diode. Some breathe like weather. A few are almost polite until you push them. Every card here is the real equation running in your browser, drawn the way the plotter draws it. Scroll sideways.</p>
    <div class="rail">
      <div class="railIn" tabindex="0" aria-label="The twenty equations, a live drawing of each">
      <figure class="eqc" data-eq="14"><div class="eqStage"><canvas></canvas><span class="n">1 / 20 &middot; flow</span></div><figcaption><b>Lorenz Attractor</b><i>Butterfly Dust</i><span>convection, weather, the butterfly</span><a class="hear" href="#strange-hear" data-clip="eq14">hear it &rarr;</a></figcaption></figure>
      <figure class="eqc" data-eq="15"><div class="eqStage"><canvas></canvas><span class="n">2 / 20 &middot; flow</span></div><figcaption><b>Halvorsen</b><i>Triple Helix</i><span>three arms pulling on each other</span><a class="hear" href="#strange-hear" data-clip="eq15">hear it &rarr;</a></figcaption></figure>
      <figure class="eqc" data-eq="18"><div class="eqStage"><canvas></canvas><span class="n">3 / 20 &middot; flow</span></div><figcaption><b>Thomas Attractor</b><i>Labyrinth</i><span>a sinuous labyrinth</span><a class="hear" href="#strange-hear" data-clip="eq18">hear it &rarr;</a></figcaption></figure>
      <figure class="eqc" data-eq="16"><div class="eqStage"><canvas></canvas><span class="n">4 / 20 &middot; flow</span></div><figcaption><b>Chua&rsquo;s Circuit</b><i>Chua Growl</i><span>a real circuit&rsquo;s double scroll</span><a class="hear" href="#strange-hear" data-clip="eq16">hear it &rarr;</a></figcaption></figure>
      <figure class="eqc" data-eq="13"><div class="eqStage"><canvas></canvas><span class="n">5 / 20 &middot; map</span></div><figcaption><b>De Jong</b><i>Ink Splatter</i><span>endless fractal terrain</span><a class="hear" href="#strange-hear" data-clip="eq13">hear it &rarr;</a></figcaption></figure>
      <figure class="eqc" data-eq="12"><div class="eqStage"><canvas></canvas><span class="n">6 / 20 &middot; map</span></div><figcaption><b>Gumowski-Mira</b><i>Mira Petals</i><span>petals from particle physics</span><a class="hear" href="#strange-hear" data-clip="eq12">hear it &rarr;</a></figcaption></figure>
      <figure class="eqc" data-eq="8"><div class="eqStage"><canvas></canvas><span class="n">7 / 20 &middot; map</span></div><figcaption><b>Ikeda Map</b><i>Laser Chatter</i><span>light folding in a ring cavity</span><a class="hear" href="#strange-hear" data-clip="eq08">hear it &rarr;</a></figcaption></figure>
      <figure class="eqc" data-eq="9"><div class="eqStage"><canvas></canvas><span class="n">8 / 20 &middot; map</span></div><figcaption><b>Tinkerbell</b><i>Pixie Dust</i><span>a curling wing</span><a class="hear" href="#strange-hear" data-clip="eq09">hear it &rarr;</a></figcaption></figure>
      <figure class="eqc" data-eq="7"><div class="eqStage"><canvas></canvas><span class="n">9 / 20 &middot; map</span></div><figcaption><b>Henon Map</b><i>Henon Fold</i><span>the fold everyone learns first</span><a class="hear" href="#strange-hear" data-clip="eq07">hear it &rarr;</a></figcaption></figure>
      <figure class="eqc" data-eq="10"><div class="eqStage"><canvas></canvas><span class="n">10 / 20 &middot; map</span></div><figcaption><b>Gingerbreadman</b><i>Glass Polygon</i><span>a hexagon that leans</span><a class="hear" href="#strange-hear" data-clip="eq10">hear it &rarr;</a></figcaption></figure>
      <figure class="eqc" data-eq="11"><div class="eqStage"><canvas></canvas><span class="n">11 / 20 &middot; map</span></div><figcaption><b>Standard Map</b><i>Kicked Rotor</i><span>the kicked rotor</span><a class="hear" href="#strange-hear" data-clip="eq11">hear it &rarr;</a></figcaption></figure>
      <figure class="eqc" data-eq="17"><div class="eqStage"><canvas></canvas><span class="n">12 / 20 &middot; flow</span></div><figcaption><b>Duffing Osc</b><i>Well Hopper</i><span>a spring with two wells</span><a class="hear" href="#strange-hear" data-clip="eq17">hear it &rarr;</a></figcaption></figure>
      <figure class="eqc" data-eq="19"><div class="eqStage"><canvas></canvas><span class="n">13 / 20 &middot; flow</span></div><figcaption><b>Van der Pol</b><i>Heartbeat</i><span>the oscillator that wants to sing</span><a class="hear" href="#strange-hear" data-clip="eq19">hear it &rarr;</a></figcaption></figure>
      <figure class="eqc" data-eq="0"><div class="eqStage"><canvas></canvas><span class="n">14 / 20 &middot; map</span></div><figcaption><b>Logistic Map</b><i>Verhulst Warmth</i><span>the parabola that started chaos theory</span><a class="hear" href="#strange-hear" data-clip="eq00">hear it &rarr;</a></figcaption></figure>
      <figure class="eqc" data-eq="1"><div class="eqStage"><canvas></canvas><span class="n">15 / 20 &middot; map</span></div><figcaption><b>Tent Map</b><i>Origami Tent</i><span>one fold, dead simple</span><a class="hear" href="#strange-hear" data-clip="eq01">hear it &rarr;</a></figcaption></figure>
      <figure class="eqc" data-eq="2"><div class="eqStage"><canvas></canvas><span class="n">16 / 20 &middot; map</span></div><figcaption><b>Cubic Map</b><i>Tube Stage</i><span>warm, odd harmonics</span><a class="hear" href="#strange-hear" data-clip="eq02">hear it &rarr;</a></figcaption></figure>
      <figure class="eqc" data-eq="3"><div class="eqStage"><canvas></canvas><span class="n">17 / 20 &middot; map</span></div><figcaption><b>Chebyshev</b><i>Overtone Glaze</i><span>harmonic order as a knob</span><a class="hear" href="#strange-hear" data-clip="eq03">hear it &rarr;</a></figcaption></figure>
      <figure class="eqc" data-eq="4"><div class="eqStage"><canvas></canvas><span class="n">18 / 20 &middot; map</span></div><figcaption><b>Bernoulli Fold</b><i>Buzzsaw</i><span>the sawtooth wrap</span><a class="hear" href="#strange-hear" data-clip="eq04">hear it &rarr;</a></figcaption></figure>

  <!-- HEAR IT: one sound, dry or through any equation, switched while it plays -->
  <section class="sec" id="strange-hear"><div class="wrap">
    <div class="k">Hear it</div>
    <h2>Play-test it here.</h2>
    <p>Pick a sound and start it dry. Then click through the equations while it plays: the loop keeps its place, so the only thing that changes is Strange. Every clip is the real plugin, one showcase preset per equation, loudness-matched to the dry so nothing wins by being louder. Quiet by default; the slider is yours.</p>

  <!-- THE PLOTTER -->
  <section class="sec"><div class="wrap">
    <div class="k">The plotter</div>
    <h2>You see what you hear.</h2>
    <p>The display isn&rsquo;t decoration. It runs the same equation as the audio, on the same values, and draws it like a pen plotter on paper: the ink drifts through colour as it goes, and every stroke dries and disappears like water on stone.</p>
    <p>The line in front is the actual transfer curve, the shape your signal is being bent through right now, with a playhead riding it. When you go quiet, so does the drawing.</p>
  </div></section>

  <hr class="rule">

  <!-- CONTROLS -->
  <section class="sec"><div class="wrap">
    <div class="k">Controls</div>
    <h2>One knob is the whole story. The rest are how you get there.</h2>
    <div class="grid g3" style="margin-top:26px">
      <div class="card"><div class="t">CHAOS</div><h3>AMOUNT</h3><p>How far into chaos. Low is warm saturation. As it rises the system period-doubles and shatters. This is the character control, and it never touches your volume.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><div class="t">CHAOS</div><h3>DRIVE &middot; DEPTH</h3><p>Drive is gain into the equation, in dB: hotter signals explore wilder regions, so it changes the flavour, not just the intensity. Depth is how many times the equation runs per sample. More passes fold the wave into denser, more fractal shapes.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><div class="t">CHAOS</div><h3>VAR A &middot; VAR B</h3><p>Two variables that mean something different for every equation, and the labels change when you switch. Right-click any knob and it tells you what it does in plain words.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><div class="t">MOTION</div><h3>FLUX &middot; SPEED &middot; FOLLOW &middot; REACT</h3><p>Flux pushes AMOUNT over time from a plain LFO, a Lorenz drift or a R&ouml;ssler pulse. Follow lets your playing push it deeper into chaos, or clean it up. At zero, it&rsquo;s fully deterministic.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><div class="t">FILTER</div><h3>LP &middot; BP &middot; HP &middot; ENV</h3><p>Low, band or high pass with resonance, and an envelope that opens the cutoff up to five octaves as you play harder. Chaos makes fierce highs. This is where you tame them.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><div class="t">OUTPUT</div><h3>MIX &middot; LEVEL</h3><p>Parallel distortion lives at 30 to 60 percent. Level is a dB trim after everything, so a preset never jumps out at you.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div></section>

  <!-- DARK -->
  <section class="sec dark"><div class="wrap two">
    <figure class="shot" style="margin:0"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," width="1100" height="887" decoding="async" alt="Strange in dark mode: the same design on ink, the plotter glowing"></figure>
    <div>
      <div class="k">Light or dark</div>
      <h2>Now in ink.</h2>
      <p>The same design on ink, the rainbow glowing on it. Pick it once in settings and every Strange window opens the way you left it.</p>
    </div>
  </div></section>

  <!-- QUIET AND QUICK -->
  <section class="sec" id="strange-inside"><div class="wrap">
    <div class="k">Under the hood</div>
    <h2>Quiet between notes. Light on the CPU.</h2>
    <div class="grid g3" style="margin-top:26px">
      <div class="card"><h3>It stays quiet.</h3><p>A chaotic system keeps moving even when you don&rsquo;t play, so most designs hiss at idle. Strange gates the wet path on what comes in: silence in, silence out, and switching equations or filters never clicks.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h3>2x oversampled, always.</h3><p>The equation runs at twice your sample rate so the fierce harmonics fold back where they belong, not onto your mix. It reports its few samples of latency to your DAW.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h3>Under 4% of a core.</h3><p>Measured at a 128-sample buffer on an Apple silicon Mac. Stack it on every track that wants it.</p></div>
    </div>
    <div style="margin-top:34px" class="two">
      <div>
        <div class="k">Presets</div>
        <h2 style="font-size:clamp(22px,2.8vw,30px)">62 presets, sorted by equation.</h2>
        <p>Every preset leans on a different part of the instrument, so flipping through them shows you the range, not variations on a default. Save your own, and they sort in beside ours.</p>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="k">Help, where you need it</div>
        <h2 style="font-size:clamp(22px,2.8vw,30px)">Right-click anything.</h2>
        <p>Every knob and switch has a plain-language card behind it, written for the equation you have selected. No manual to go find.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div></section>

  <!-- FAQ -->
  <section class="sec" itemscope itemtype="https://schema.org/FAQPage"><div class="wrap">
    <div class="k">Questions</div>
    <h2>The short answers.</h2>
    <details itemscope itemprop="mainEntity" itemtype="https://schema.org/Question"><summary itemprop="name">Which DAWs does it work in?</summary><div itemscope itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer"><p itemprop="text">Any host that loads VST3 or AU: Ableton Live, Logic, FL Studio, Reaper, Bitwig and the rest. There&rsquo;s a standalone app too, for when you just want to play into it.</p></div></details>
    <details itemscope itemprop="mainEntity" itemtype="https://schema.org/Question"><summary itemprop="name">Mac or Windows?</summary><div itemscope itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer"><p itemprop="text">Mac today, as a universal build for Apple silicon and Intel on macOS 10.13 and later.</p></div></details>
    <details itemscope itemprop="mainEntity" itemtype="https://schema.org/Question"><summary itemprop="name">Is it heavy on the CPU?</summary><div itemscope itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer"><p itemprop="text">No. Under 4% of one core at a 128-sample buffer on an Apple silicon Mac, with the equation running 2x oversampled the whole time.</p></div></details>
    <details itemscope itemprop="mainEntity" itemtype="https://schema.org/Question"><summary itemprop="name">Does it add latency?</summary><div itemscope itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer"><p itemprop="text">A few samples, from the oversampling, and Strange reports them to your DAW so everything stays lined up.</p></div></details>
    <details itemscope itemprop="mainEntity" itemtype="https://schema.org/Question"><summary itemprop="name">Is the display really the equation?</summary><div itemscope itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemtype="https://schema.org/Answer"><p itemprop="text">Yes. The plotter runs the same math as the audio path on the same live values, so it can&rsquo;t show you something you aren&rsquo;t hearing.</p></div></details>
    <div class="foot">
      <span>Clay and Kelsy Instruments, our cute little software company. Built by the two of us in a home studio surrounded by trees.</span>
      <span><a href="https://clayandkelsy.com/plugins/">all our plugins &rarr;</a></span>
    </div>
  </div></section>
